description: Every number printed in main.tex, with the artifact it is recomputed from. Paths are relative to work/microfluidic_reliability (see SOURCES in tools/check_numbers.py). 'dec' is the printed precision; 'scale' multiplies the artifact value (100 = fraction to percent); 'cooccur' is a regex that must appear within 'window' characters of every occurrence in the .tex (denominator wording); 'tex_optional' entries verify the artifact value only. Entries prefixed w3./d3. point at w3_artifacts_canonical_run2/ and d3_blind_artifacts/ (relative to --work) for Sections R8/R9. Entries prefixed p2. are the post-hoc round-2 analyses in posthoc_review_round2/ (retrospective, not pre-registered). Entries prefixed w4. point at w4_artifacts_canonical_run2/ (uncertainty-aware comparison models; frozen W4 protocol). Entries prefixed w5. point at w5_artifacts_canonical_run2/ (covariate-shift-weighted conformal; frozen W5 protocol).
